item.title: Algebraic $\mathbb{A}^{1}$-invariance of K-theory for affinoid Tate adic spaces of good reduction
item.description: arXiv:2611.05111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish homotopy invariance for connective continuous K-theory of affinoid Tate adic spaces of good reduction with respect to the algebraic affine line, distinct from the adic affine line as analytic stacks. We approach this through an investigation of boundedness of t-structures on nuclear module categories, to which end we also study ultrasolid modules, a variant of solid modules, and their properties.
item.dc:creator: Hyungseop Kim

item.title: $K$-theory of finite monoid sets
item.description: arXiv:2611.05265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we classify the algebraic K-theory of sets equipped with an action by a finite abelian monoid. The main tool developed for this purpose is an Orbit-Stabilizer Theorem, which gives a decomposition of monoid sets analogous to the decomposition given by the Orbit-Stabilizer Theorem for G-sets.
item.dc:creator: Maru Sarazola, Brandon T. Shapiro, Inna Zakharevich

item.title: Witt groups of smooth real curves and surfaces
item.description: arXiv:2608.18599v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the $\mathbf{I}^*$-cohomology of a smooth real algebraic curve in terms of its real locus and its geometric genus. We notably extend results of Knebusch and Monnier to the twisted case. We further describe how to compute twisted Witt groups of surfaces, generalising work of Sujatha, and apply our results to the computation of the shifted and twisted Witt groups of the smooth real anisotropic quadric surface. Finally, we extend Monnier's investigation of the image of the global signature homomorphism for surfaces.
item.dc:creator: Samuel Lerbet
